slides.title: 4. In-use preparation and resuspension
bullets: XA-5 is a suspension: preparation before sampling is part of the reported protocol.
Interpret assay against the documented resuspension procedure, not against an undisturbed container.
The resuspension assessment supported the dosing instructions.
The shake-before-use instruction carries that preparation requirement into use.
slides.notes: Saira Mahmood reviewed analytical interpretation; Dr L. Wu retained the storage and sampling link. This readout reports ICH chamber programme work and does not present a separate method-validation deliverable.
slides.footer: Westravelle Analytical Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: 5. Impurity trend by storage interval
slides.notes: The resuspension assessment supported the dosing instructions. The plot is a view of the approved stability table; the table supplies condition, interval and compliance status. Do not extrapolate beyond {{PRJ0095:stability.last_timepoint_months}} months.
slides.footer: Westravelle Analytical Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: 6. System suitability and deviation disposition
bullets: Saira Mahmood: analytical method and system suitability review.
Dr L. Wu: reconciliation of preparation, storage and sequence identity.
Dr A. Penrose: approved interpretation and client release.
bullets_right: Approved sequence sheets are the authority for suitability acceptance and any repeat sequence.
Deviation notes remain linked to the affected batch card; this deck does not replace their disposition.
No additional chamber excursion, reinjection or acceptance limit is inferred from the trend plot.
slides.notes: Readout source: XA5_PULLS_AND_SUITABILITY_RESULTS_Rev03.xlsx. Distinguish an observed formulation or packaging effect from an analytical deviation. The resuspension assessment supported the dosing instructions.
slides.footer: Westravelle Analytical Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: 7. Interpretation for transfer
bullets: The resuspension assessment supported the dosing instructions.
Xarnelvune added a shake-before-use instruction.
Include the shake-before-use instruction in the dosing text and retain the resuspension procedure with the in-use protocol.
Conclusion applies to tested storage conditions and the reported {{PRJ0095:stability.last_timepoint_months}}-month interval.
slides.notes: The dosing instruction is supported by the resuspension assessment. The readout does not establish the outcome of dosing without shaking.
slides.footer: Westravelle Analytical Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential
